newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Hilton Hotels Corp started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Hilton Hotels Corp started.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co said Monday it initiated coverage of Hilton Hotels Corp with an aggressive buy rating and a 12-month price target of $35.
-- McDonald said the rating was based on the company's strong market position in the hospitality industry, its aggressive management team and solid near-term fundamentals.

-- Hilton shares are attractive regardless of whether it completes its proposed acquisition of ITT Corp for $55 a share, McDonald said. ITT management has refused to meet to discuss the proposal, McDonald said.
-- Hilton owned or partially owned 31 hotels, had 28 management contracts and 172 franchised hotels at the end of 1996.
-- Hlton shares were unchanged Monday at 25-1/8.
